### pipeline-recon | kinds=read,read,read,read,read | flags=
journalctl -u nginx --no-pager | grep -i error | sed 's/x/y/' | sort | uniq -c

### pipeline-awk | kinds=read,read,read,read,read,read | flags=
cat /var/log/syslog | awk '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20

### ss-grep | kinds=read,read | flags=
ss -tulpn | grep 443

### ip-show | kinds=read | flags=
ip addr show

### ip-add | kinds=write | flags=
ip addr add 192.0.2.5/32 dev eth0

### journal-vacuum | kinds=write | flags=
journalctl --vacuum-time=7d

### docker-stats | kinds=read | flags=
docker stats --no-stream

### docker-stats-stream | kinds=unknown | flags=
docker stats
